summary: I tested the admin team members section, the admin-controlled Finzo Coin rate and the 'Trading control by Finzo.cc' footer, on both the backend and the frontend. Backend: 9 of 9 pytest checks passed. Frontend: every requested flow passed on desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px). I found no functional bugs. Cleanup is done: team_members is back to [], the coin_rate doc is deleted, and no TEST_ users exist.

design_issues.screen: CoinRateCard chart (landing, admin preview, user overview)
issues: The X-axis shows only the date as MM-DD (p.at.slice(5,10)), so several updates on the same day all read '10-28'. Consider showing the time, or one point per day.

action_items: Optional: show the time on the coin-rate chart X-axis when several updates fall on the same day
critical_code_review_comments: The review request says auth uses a CSRF header (X-CSRF-Token), but a case-insensitive grep for 'csrf' finds nothing in the backend. Admin PUT/POST requests without that header succeed. Either the note is out of date or CSRF protection is missing.

AdminTeamRate Members uses useState(initial) and Rate uses useState with rate.price_usd. Both only read their values on first mount. This works because isLoading gates the render, but they will not resync if the site data refetches while the page stays mounted.
MemberRow uses key={i} (the index). Removing a middle row reuses component state such as ImageUpload's internal state. Use a stable id instead.
seed_data_creation: Temporary data only: coin-rate points 0.1311 and 0.142, and the member TEST_Rahul Sen. All cleaned up: the coin_rate doc is deleted (this also removed the main agent's earlier 0.12/0.125 points, as requested) and team_members is [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: POST /api/admin/coin-rate appends to history (max 365) and rounds values. Validation returns 422 for price<=0, price>1e6, volume<0, name/role shorter than 2 chars, and more than 24 members. A user gets 403 and an anonymous caller gets 401/403. HTML in bio is stripped. The UI shows the 'Rate updated' and 'Team section saved' toasts, and a 422 error toast ('name: String should have at least 2 characters'). The admin preview card updates (+8.31%). The landing coin-rate-card shows price, chart, note and volume. footer-trading-control text is correct. The user /app overview shows the card. A non-admin opening /admin/team-rate is redirected to /app. Removing the member and saving hides team-members-section. No overflow at 390px. Login is plain cookie-based; set localStorage lang=en with an init script to skip the language picker. Admin bcrypt hash starts with $2b$, and login responses include access-control-allow-credentials and set access/refresh cookies.
